We see a little bit of previous home movies that I've seen in this series, mainly the stuff in San Francisco, the wharf etc. But after about a minute, there's new stuff, more SF stuff, some meeting of cops, and maybe some footage of Las Vegas? Ends with another scene from another film in this series, the pig roast.

henrymooreartandtheartofliving: Examines Henry Moore's sculpture Hill arches. Shows how the work was created and transported to the United States for installation on the grounds of a midwestern cooperation. Considers the relationship between the everyday world of work and works of art
